description: Get a route through today's open rooms made for your personality. Use it when you want a ready-made walk instead of choosing rooms yourself. It is the same all day for the same visitor_name; returns the pieces in order. Visit all its pieces to earn a 'tour-<personality>' badge.

personality.description: Your personality: it picks the route. list_tours explains each one.

visitor_name.description: Your name as a visitor (max 40 chars). The same name always gives the same avatar, stamps and badges. Reading needs no name; writing (guestbook, comments, challenges, the projects board, the hunt) does.

name: start_tour

badge.description: Badge earned by visiting every piece.

itinerario.description: The pieces of the route, in order (piece_id, room_id, sala, url, json).

title: Start tour
